brand.name: iVogue Lusaka
brand.promise: Fashion-grade iPhones, fitted and styled in Lusaka.

store.mapsQuery: East Park Mall, Great East Road, Lusaka

payments.vatNote: Prices include all import duty and taxes. VAT is not charged separately on retail handsets at this registration.

policies.warrantyNew: 12 months on all sealed iPhones, Apple Watch and AirPods.
policies.warrantyPreowned: 90 days on certified pre-owned handsets, parts and labour.
policies.returns: 7 days for an unopened, unregistered item with the receipt. Opened sealed items are exchange-or-repair only.
policies.swapWindow: 48 hours to swap a pre-owned unit for another of equal value if it misbehaves.

trust.title: Tested in front of you
trust.text: Every handset is unboxed, booted, IMEI-checked and battery-tested at the counter before you pay.

trust.title: Receipt with the IMEI on it
trust.text: Printed receipt with model, IMEI, storage, colour and battery health. That receipt is your warranty.

trust.title: Mobile money or card
trust.text: Airtel Money, MTN MoMo, Zamtel Kwacha, Visa and Mastercard. No cash-only pressure.

trust.title: Same-day Lusaka delivery
trust.text: Ordered before 15:00 inside Lusaka? It reaches you the same day, insured.
